parole.testo: Via other European languages, ultimately borrowed from Spanish aguacate, itself a borrowing from Nahuatl āhuacatl. In Europe, the term was also influenced by confusion with Spanish abogado (“lawyer”).

parole.significato: mosquito (small insects (family: Culicidae, especially those in tropical regions) that bite and suck blood)
parole.testo: Via some other European language, ultimately borrowed from Spanish mosquito.

parole.significato: platinum (metallic chemical element, with atomic number 78.)
parole.testo: Via some other European language, ultimately from Spanish platina (“little silver”), the diminutive form of plata (“silver”), because platinum was found as an apparent impurity with silver.
